title: Calendar Daily Agenda
description: Emails tomorrow's calendar events to one recipient, defaulting to the script owner's own address. Add a morning time-driven trigger for a daily agenda.
setup: Create a script project and copy in Code.gs and appsscript.json.
Optionally set Script Properties: AGENDA_RECIPIENT, AGENDA_CALENDAR.
Run sendDailyAgenda() once and check the inbox and execution log.
Add a morning time-driven trigger for a daily agenda.

title: Drive File Organizer
description: Moves files from one Drive folder into subfolders by type (Documents, Spreadsheets, Presentations, Images, PDFs, Other). Dry-run is on by default.
setup: Create a script project and copy in Code.gs and appsscript.json.
Run organizeDriveFolder() once and check the execution log (dry run).
Set DRY_RUN to false only when the log looks right, then run it again.

title: Gmail Inbox Triage
description: Labels threads matching a Gmail search query and optionally archives them. Dry-run is on by default, so it logs what it would do before changing anything.
setup: Create a script project and copy in Code.gs and appsscript.json.
Set Script Properties: TRIAGE_QUERY, TRIAGE_LABEL, ARCHIVE_AFTER, DRY_RUN.
Run triageInbox() once and check the execution log (dry run).
Set DRY_RUN to false only when the log looks right, then run it again.

title: Sheet Weekly Report
description: Reads a spreadsheet, counts its data rows, optionally sums a numeric column, and emails the summary. All IDs and the recipient live in Script Properties.
setup: Create a script project and copy in Code.gs and appsscript.json.
Set Script Properties: REPORT_SPREADSHEET_ID, REPORT_RECIPIENT, REPORT_SHEET_NAME, REPORT_AMOUNT_COLUMN.
Run sendWeeklyReport() once and check the inbox and execution log.
Add a weekly time-driven trigger when the report looks right.
